editorial_method: Lead read the complete four Chinese reader essays, four original optional observations and complete index/source notices.

Each foreign article and ancillary field was read in full by a different editor from its author. All accepted local changes were compared with Chinese, applied and actually reread as complete saved fields.
Every concrete example, counterargument and unresolved boundary remains. Source-unit alignment supplements reading; it is not a quality score.
The four closing observations remain voluntary, without scores, model answers, personality grading or a guarantee of improvement. They are not converted into a questionnaire.
browser_checks: Japanese index displays all four essays and the full non-ranking map as peers, not an upgrade ladder.
The cooperative Japanese essay displays its complete optional observation and no-score/no-model-answer/no-personality-grading note after, not inside, the full body.
Actual eight-language switching preserves the cooperative article when moving Japanese to Spanish and then back to the original English mode.
The Spanish article kicker names the series once, rather than duplicating the prefixed manuscript label.
At 375px, the language menu remains visible in two columns, navigation becomes one column and document width does not overflow. There are no form/input/select assessment controls.
Temporary mobile viewport was reset after testing.
proof_image_location: Local Codex workspace; not added to the public site payload.
limits: AI-assisted independent editorial review, not human native-speaker certification.
Existing English and Chinese prose was preserved, not newly rewritten or recertified as technical-paper translation.
deployment: One local series commit; author pushes.
